subject: English
question_text: What are the causes of higher illiteracy rate in a country?
stimulus: In order to know whether a nation is rich or poor, developed or undeveloped one does not need to count the number of its palatial buildings and monuments or the number of these people who enjoy a high standard of living. It is enough to count the numbers of its literate people. The literacy or illiteracy rate in a country determines whether it is rich or poor, developed or undeveloped. The higher the rate of illiteracy of a country, the greater will be the extent of poverty and backwardness, Illiteracy is a curse. It is the root cause of ignorance which frustrates all development efforts of the government and the community. No development efforts can be successful unless illiteracy is eradicated. Educating the illiterate in a country like Bangladesh with vast population is undoubtedly a gigantic task. No individual community or organization, not even government is capable of solving this huge problem single handed. It is the social responsibility of all literate people men and women make some concerted efforts to remove illiteracy from the society.
source: SSC English 1st Paper Test Paper 12 — Barisal Cadet College
